lines.en: label cafe50:
scene cafefifty1
I make my way into the cafe to find things a little busier than normal this morning.
lines.zh: 我走进咖啡馆，发现今天早上比平时热闹一些。

lines.en: It’s particularly windy today, so I figure that might have something to do with it.
lines.zh: 今天风特别大，所以我觉得这可能跟那有点关系。

lines.en: Does wind make cafes busier? That sounds like a thing.
lines.zh: 刮风会让咖啡馆更热闹吗？听起来像是这么回事。

lines.en: Either way, I am prepared to order myself a hot beverage and immediately vacate the premises because there is clearly no reason for me to ever stay here.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我准备好给自己点一杯热饮，然后立刻撤离现场，因为显然我没有任何理由待在这儿。

lines.en: That’s right. I said there is no reason for me to ever stay here.
lines.zh: 没错。我说了我没有任何理由待在这儿。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene cafefifty2
: Yo! Sorry for the wait. Been a little wild this morning, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 哟！抱歉让你久等。今天早上有点疯，你懂的。

lines.en: : What else could that possibly mean apart from the cafe being busy?
lines.zh: : 除了咖啡馆很忙之外，那还能是什么意思？

lines.en: : Beats me. Maybe I killed someone on the way to work? You know...found a machete and just went to town on an innocent bystander.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。也许我在上班路上杀了个人？你知道的……捡了把砍刀，然后对某个无辜的路人一阵乱砍。

lines.en: else:
: Sundays, am I right?
lines.zh: : 周日嘛，对吧？

lines.en: : Sure, Rin.
lines.zh: : 说得对，Rin。

lines.en: : So, I’m gonna assume you’re here to congratulate me on the fact that I have a girlfriend now, right?
lines.zh: : 那么，我猜你是来恭喜我现在有女朋友了，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m actually here to order a drink.
lines.zh: : 我其实是来点饮料的。

lines.en: scene cafefifty3
: What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Because that is literally the purpose of this building.
lines.zh: : 因为这栋楼存在的意义本来就是这个。

lines.en: : No. The purpose of this building is giving you and me some time to chill outside of[school] while {i}also{/i} allowing me to get paid.
lines.zh: : 不对。这栋楼的用途，是给你和我一些在校外闲逛的时间，同时{i}还{/i}能让我拿到工资。

lines.en: : Right. So what does that mean for the days that I {i}don’t{/i} come here?
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我{i}不{/i}来的那些天呢？

lines.en: scene cafefifty4
: On those days, I normally just sit around frowning...hoping you’ll show up to keep me company.
lines.zh: : 那种日子，我一般就坐在那儿愁眉苦脸……盼着你会出现来陪我。

lines.en: scene cafefifty5
: Or at least that’s what I {i}would{/i} be doing if I didn’t have a girlfriend now!
lines.zh: : 或者说，如果我现在没有女朋友的话，我{i}大概{/i}就是在干这个！

lines.en: : So, did you hear that I have a girlfriend now? Because I totally have a girlfriend now.
lines.zh: : 所以，你听说我现在有女朋友了吗？因为我现在真的有个女朋友了。

lines.en: : Like, a real one. Not just a picture of a girl I like that I carry around in my wallet and whisper sweet nothings to when no one is looking.
lines.zh: : 就是那种，货真价实的。不是那种我偷偷喜欢的女生的照片，塞在钱包里随身带着、趁没人看的时候对她轻声说情话的那种。

lines.en: : Is that...a thing you actually do? Or {i}have{/i} done?
lines.zh: : 那……是你真的做过、或者{i}曾经{/i}做过的事？

lines.en: scene cafefifty6
: What? No. Weren’t you listening?
lines.zh: : 什么？没有。你没在听吗？

lines.en: : Besides, who prints out pictures anymore? Just set a picture of the girl you secretly like as your lock screen and move on like everybody else.
lines.zh: : 再说，现在谁还把照片打印出来啊？把偷偷喜欢的女生的照片设成锁屏，然后像其他人一样该干嘛干嘛。

lines.en: : Which reminds me, I have a girlfriend now.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，我现在有女朋友了。

lines.en: : Wow, really? I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 哇，真的吗？我完全不知道。

lines.en: scene cafefifty7
: Rin, as happy as I am for you, I {i}kind of{/i} need you...actually working today.
lines.zh: : Rin，我为你高兴是高兴，不过我{i}多少{/i}需要你……真的干点活。

lines.en: : I kind of need you to congratulate me on the fact that I have a girlfriend now.
lines.zh: : 我多少需要你恭喜一下我现在有女朋友了。

lines.en: scene cafefifty8
: I’ve congratulated you like ten times today alone. I can’t keep doing this for the rest of forever. It’s wasting too many words.
lines.zh: : 光是今天我就已经恭喜你十次了。我不能永远这么恭喜下去。太浪费词了。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Fine. You’re off the hook for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: : 好好好。行。今天剩下的时间就放过你。

lines.en: : But if my {i}girlfriend{/i} finds out that you don’t care about her, you can bet those huge mommy milkers of yours that she’ll have something to say about it.
lines.zh: : 不过要是我的{i}女朋友{/i}发现你不在乎她，你尽管拿你那对巨大的奶子打赌，她肯定会说点什么的。

lines.en: : Just kidding. Otoha is really nice.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。Otoha 人真的很好。

lines.en: : Otoha is my girlfriend, by the way. We’re dating now.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，Otoha 是我女朋友。我们现在在交往。

lines.en: scene cafefifty9
: You didn’t bring a leash, did you?
lines.zh: : 你没带牵引绳吧？

lines.en: : I wish.
lines.zh: : 我倒是希望带了。

lines.en: : Careful, Sensei. The only girl who can put me on a leash is Otoha. My girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 小心点，Sensei。唯一能给我套上牵引绳的女孩是 Otoha。我女朋友。

lines.en: : We’ll see about that, Rin.
lines.zh: : 这个我们走着瞧，Rin。

lines.en: scene cafefifty10
: Wait, we will? Why do you sound so sure?
lines.zh: : 等等，走着瞧？你怎么听起来那么确定？

lines.en: : Just a hunch.
lines.zh: : 只是直觉。

lines.en: : Ominous.
lines.zh: : 不祥。

lines.en: : Make sure you check with my girlfriend first. Her name is Otoha, by the way. She’s the one who is dating me. Have you heard of her?
lines.zh: : 记得先问过我女朋友。她叫 Otoha，顺便说一句。就是那个正在跟我交往的人。你听说过她吗？

lines.en: : Never.
lines.zh: : 从来没有。

lines.en: : But anyway, how are you doing, Haruka? You seem easier to talk to in your current mental state.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，你最近怎么样，Haruka？以你现在的精神状态，感觉更好聊一些。

lines.en: scene cafefifty11
: Hey! I’ll have you know that {i}my{/i} current mental state is better than ever! I’m totally happy and totally cool!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我要你知道，{i}我的{/i}精神状态前所未有的好！我超级开心、超级酷！

lines.en: : Oh, uhh...I’m doing well.
lines.zh: : 哦，呃……我还挺好的。

lines.en: : Just trying to keep things afloat in here, which is admittedly a little tough when my best employee is now somehow {i}worse{/i} at her job after getting a...girlfriend, I think it was?
lines.zh: : 只是在努力维持这里的运转，说实话，当我最好的员工在交了个……女朋友之后，工作表现反而{i}更差{/i}了，这确实有点难办。

lines.en: : If this is your best, you might want to look into hiring a few more girls.
lines.zh: : 如果这就是你的最佳水平，你大概该考虑再多招几个女孩。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Yeah. Now that Rin has a girlfriend, it’s fine to just make fun of her all day. I see how it is.
lines.zh: : 哦，好的。是啊。现在 Rin 有女朋友了，就可以一整天拿她开玩笑了。我算是看明白了。

lines.en: : You two wait until my girlfriend hears about this. She’ll show you what’s up.
lines.zh: : 你们两个等着，等我女朋友听说了这事，她会让你们好看的。

lines.en: : Her name is-
lines.zh: : 她叫——

lines.en: scene cafefifty12
: Okay, seriously? Stop.
lines.zh: : 好了，认真的？停下。

lines.en: : Ugh. Fine. I’ll keep doing my job.
lines.zh: : 呃。行吧。我继续干活。

lines.en: : If I’m ever going to inherit the family business, I can’t be slacking off like this.
lines.zh: : 如果我要继承家族生意，可不能这么偷懒。

lines.en: : Thank-
scene cafefifty13
: Wait, are we related now? How is this a “family” business?
lines.zh: : 等等，我们现在是亲戚了吗？这怎么成了「家族」生意？

lines.en: : You’re kinda like a mom to me, aren’t you? You’ve definitely got the boobs of one.
lines.zh: : 你对我来说有点像妈妈，不是吗？你的胸绝对够格。

lines.en: : Can we stop talking about my boobs? Also, there are plenty of mothers out there who-
lines.zh: : 我们能别聊我的胸吗？再说，世上有很多母亲——

lines.en: : You’re also just as related to me as my actual mom. So yeah, basically a family member.
lines.zh: : 而且你跟我亲妈的关系也就差不多。所以啊，基本上就是家人。

lines.en: : If I’m not in your will, I’m gonna be really pissed.
lines.zh: : 要是你的遗嘱里没有我，我可真要气死了。

lines.en: : Okay. You know what? There’s a customer in the corner who just ordered a vanilla latte.
lines.zh: : 行吧。你知道吗？角落里那位客人刚点了一杯香草拿铁。

lines.en: : If you can get it to them in less than two minutes, I’ll add you to my will. If not, I’m leaving the cafe to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 如果你能在两分钟内送到，我就把你加进遗嘱。做不到的话，我就把咖啡馆留给 Sensei。

lines.en: scene cafefifty14
: Over my dead body...
lines.zh: : 除非我死了……

lines.en: : Take your time, Rin. Inheriting a business for literally nothing sounds like a pretty sweet deal.
lines.zh: : 慢慢来，Rin。平白无故继承一门生意，听起来是相当不错的买卖。

lines.en: : The only thing {i}you’re{/i} going to inherit is...disappointment.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}唯一会继承到的，是……失望。

lines.en: : Cool. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 酷。谢了。

lines.en: scene cafefifty15
: Hah...
else:
: Sundays, am I right?
lines.zh: : 周日嘛，对吧？

lines.en: : You know...I really do see the nonbiological resemblance.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我真的看出了那种非血缘的相似之处。

lines.en: : And I would also like to take this moment to confirm that I like your breasts just as much as Rin appears to.
lines.zh: : 而且我也想借这个机会确认一下，我和 Rin 一样喜欢你的胸部。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
scene cafefifty16
: Yeah...I am quite aware of that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我相当清楚这一点。

lines.en: : You don’t really need to remind me.
lines.zh: : 你真不用提醒我。

lines.en: else:
scene cafefifty16
: Watch it. We’re just {i}friends{/i}, remember?
lines.zh: : 注意点。我们只是{i}朋友{/i}，记得吗？

lines.en: : Saying things like that is something we should try to avoid for both of our sakes.
lines.zh: : 为了我们两个好，这种话还是尽量别说。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I get it.
lines.zh: : 行行行。我懂。

lines.en: : Anyway, if you’re concerned about her carrying this on for much longer, you probably don’t have to worry.
lines.zh: : 总之，如果你担心她会这么继续闹下去，你大概不用操心。

lines.en: scene cafefifty17
: You’re not rooting for those two to fail, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是在盼着她们俩黄掉吧？

lines.en: : Better not be!
lines.zh: : 最好不要是！

lines.en: : No. I just mean that Rin is naturally obsessive and probably just wants to get some of that rare...{i}true{/i} happy energy out of her or something.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是说 Rin 天生就容易执念，大概只是想把那股罕见的……{i}真正的{/i}快乐能量从身体里释放出来之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m not really well-versed in what it means to feel happy and...do happy things.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我实在不太懂「感到幸福」和……做幸福的事意味着什么。

lines.en: scene cafefifty18
: Uhh...sorry?
lines.zh: : 呃……抱歉？

lines.en: : Is this a cry for help? Do you need a shoulder to dry all your tears of loneliness on?
lines.zh: : 这是在求救吗？你需要一个肩膀来擦干你所有孤独的泪水吗？

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。

lines.en: scene cafefifty19
: Good. Because I do. And if we both had to cry, the angles would be all weird and we’d probably just be crying into the air.
lines.zh: : 那就好。因为我需要。要是我们两个都得哭，角度会很奇怪，大概就只能对着空气哭了。

lines.en: : Are you feeling even lonelier than normal, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 你今天比平时更孤独吗，Haruka？

lines.en: scene cafefifty20
: I mean...not any more than {i}normal{/i}. But my default state is enough to make most people want to cry.
lines.zh: : 嗯……没有比{i}平时{/i}更甚。不过我的默认状态已经足够让大多数人想哭了。

lines.en: : All things considered, though. It hasn’t really been that bad lately.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，最近其实也没那么糟。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to stay focused on the business and-
lines.zh: : 我只是想专心经营这家店，然后——

lines.en: scene cafefifty21
: Ah-
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene cafefifty22
: Rin? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : Rin？你怎么了？

lines.en: : Should we...do something?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要……做点什么？

lines.en: scene cafefifty23
: Uhh...Rin? You okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……Rin？你还好吗？

lines.en: : That’s weird. Wasn’t I just...
lines.zh: : 好奇怪。我刚刚不是……

lines.en: scene cafefifty24
: Ah! Crap!
lines.zh: : 啊！糟了！

lines.en: : I’ll get a broom! And a...mop!
lines.zh: : 我去拿扫帚！还有……拖把！

lines.en: : Cleaning stuff! Yeah!
lines.zh: : 清洁工具！对！

lines.en: : Gonna...Gonna go do that!
lines.zh: : 我要……我要去干那个！

lines.en: : Be right back!
lines.zh: : 马上回来！

lines.en: scene black
Rin scurries off to the back of the cafe and returns moments later with a mop bucket and a broom to sweep up the broken glass of the mug she dropped.
lines.zh: Rin 匆匆跑到咖啡馆后面，片刻后提着拖把桶和扫帚回来，清扫她摔碎的杯子碎片。

lines.en: Not really sure how to handle the situation, I stand around and wait for things to pass while Haruka makes another drink for the customer who just lost theirs.
lines.zh: 不太确定该怎么处理这个状况，我干站着等事情过去，而 Haruka 给那位刚失去饮料的客人重新做了一杯。

lines.en: After a few minutes, Rin finishes cleaning and returns to the two of us.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，Rin 打扫完，回到了我们两个身边。

lines.en: scene cafefifty25
: So, uhh...whoops! Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……哎呀！哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Guess mistakes happen to even the best of us, right?
lines.zh: : 看来再厉害的人也会犯错，对吧？

lines.en: : You can deduct whatever the cost of that mug was from my paycheck. It’s my fault, so I don’t really mind.
lines.zh: : 那只杯子的钱从我工资里扣就行。是我的错，我一点都不介意。

lines.en: : I’m not really worried about the mug. I just want to make sure you’re feeling okay since you...seemed a little out of it just now.
lines.zh: : 我倒不担心杯子。我只是想确认你感觉还好，因为你……刚刚看起来有点魂不守舍。

lines.en: scene cafefifty26
: Nah, dude. I’m good. My hand just twitched or something. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没啦，老兄。我没事。我的手就是抽了一下什么的。没事的。

lines.en: : No lightheadedness or...nausea or anything like that?
lines.zh: : 没有头晕或者……恶心之类的？

lines.en: : You’ve been running around all morning, so-
lines.zh: : 你一早上都在跑来跑去，所以——

lines.en: : No nothing, Haruka. Won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有，Haruka。不会再发生了。

lines.en: : Have you gone on break yet today?
lines.zh: : 你今天休息过了吗？

lines.en: scene cafefifty27
: Hm? Even {i}you’re{/i} worried? But...you’re like the...paragon of not worrying about stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯？连{i}你{/i}也担心？可你可是……不为任何事操心的典范啊。

lines.en: : He’s probably worried as a friend. Not an authority figure or teacher or...counselor or whatever other jobs he neglects.
lines.zh: : 他大概是作为朋友在担心。不是作为什么权威人物、老师或者……心理咨询师，或者其他他疏于履行的身份。

lines.en: : Thank you, Haruka. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Haruka。我很感激。

lines.en: : And not to throw away another title so soon after getting it, but I’m not really worried right now either.
lines.zh: : 而且我刚得到这个称号就要把它丢掉，不过我现在其实也不担心。

lines.en: : I just think your {i}new girlfriend{/i} might get a little upset if her lover collapsed at work.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，她的{i}新女朋友{/i}要是看到自己的爱人晕倒在岗位上，可能会有点不高兴。

lines.en: scene cafefifty28
: L-Lover?...I mean...what even is “love,” you know?
lines.zh: : 爱、爱人？……我是说……「爱」到底是什么啊，你知道吗？

lines.en: : It’s still way too early to be using words like that because it would make whoever said it first clingy. And if there is anything Rin Rokuhara {i}isn’t{/i}, it’s clingy.
lines.zh: : 现在用这种词还太早了，因为谁先说谁就显得黏人。而如果说 Rin Rokuhara {i}绝不{/i}是什么的话，那就是绝不黏人。

lines.en: : Besides, how can I even {i}be{/i} clingy when we only kissed the one time?
lines.zh: : 再说了，我们才亲了一次，我怎么可能{i}变得{/i}黏人？

lines.en: : And even then, it was only for a few seconds.
lines.zh: : 而且那一次也只亲了几秒钟。

lines.en: : Was it a good few seconds? Yeah. It was awesome. But it was only a few seconds. There’s no way I {i}love{/i} her, you know?
lines.zh: : 那几秒钟美好吗？是啊。棒极了。可也就几秒钟而已。我怎么可能{i}爱{/i}她呢，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Do you want to go on break a little early today, Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin，你要不要今天早点休息？

lines.en: scene cafefifty29
: What, like now? But we’re still super busy and I’m totally fine. I swear.
lines.zh: : 什么，就现在？可我们还超级忙，而且我真的没事。我发誓。

lines.en: : I’ll manage. Besides, Sensei doesn’t typically spend entire days here, and I’m sure you want to talk a little more about Otoha with him.
lines.zh: : 我一个人能撑。再说，Sensei 一般也不会在这儿待一整天，而且我肯定你想跟他多聊点 Otoha 的事。

lines.en: : I mean...kiiiiind of. But there’s not much to say.
lines.zh: : 嗯……有、有点吧。不过也没什么好说的。

lines.en: : I’m right here, you know. You can tell me that directly.
lines.zh: : 我就在这儿，你知道的。你可以直接跟我说。

lines.en: scene cafefifty30
: Sure. There’s not much to say.
lines.zh: : 行吧。没什么好说的。

lines.en: : You sure sounded like you had a lot to say earlier. Granted, it was mostly just repeating the same thing over and over again.
lines.zh: : 你刚才听起来明明有一大堆想说的。虽说大部分只是把同一件事翻来覆去说。

lines.en: : Just take her outside and give her a breath of fresh air or something. She’s been in here since we opened and could probably use it.
lines.zh: : 带她出去透透气什么的吧。她从开门到现在一直待在里面，大概需要一下。

lines.en: : I’d kind of rather we stayed inside on account of the whole...evil winter wind thing going on outside.
lines.zh: : 我倒更想待在屋里，因为外面刮着那种……邪恶的冬风。

lines.en: : Then I guess we’ll just do that.
lines.zh: : 那我们就待屋里吧。

lines.en: : Can it be on the couch, though? I still feel awkward about spilling that one customer’s drink and I don’t want them looking at me like I ruined their day.
lines.zh: : 不过能在沙发上吗？我打翻了那位客人的饮料，还是觉得挺尴尬的，不想让他们用那种「你毁了我一天」的眼神看我。

lines.en: : You certainly have a lot of demands for your break.
lines.zh: : 你休息一下的要求还真多。

lines.en: : Dude, I only get one. I’ve gotta make it the best possible break I can.
lines.zh: : 老兄，我只有一次休息。我得把它变成能有的最好的一次休息。

lines.en: : Outlooks like that are better aimed toward more vague concepts like life as a whole.
lines.zh: : 这种心态，更适合用在「人生整体」这类更笼统的概念上。

lines.en: : But what does it mean to {i}live?{/i} What if we’re all trapped in some sort of simulation, and one day we’ll all wake up and have, like...cheese for eyes or something?
lines.zh: : 可{i}活着{/i}到底是什么意思？万一我们都困在某种模拟里，有一天醒来发现，眼睛变成了……奶酪什么的？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. It’s possible.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。是有可能的。

lines.en: : What if all we are is just cheese in general? What kind would {i}I{/i} be? Mozzarella? Gouda?
lines.zh: : 万一我们整个人就是奶酪呢？那{i}我{/i}会是什么？马苏里拉？高达？

lines.en: : What’s the most bisexual cheese? I wanna be that.
lines.zh: : 最双性恋的奶酪是哪一种？我想当那种。

lines.en: : Since a conversation like this would {i}never{/i} happen while clocked in, I’m just going to assume that Rin’s break has already begun and start counting down the time now.
lines.zh: : 这种对话{i}绝对{/i}不可能在打卡状态下发生，所以我就当 Rin 的休息已经开始了，从现在开始倒计时。

lines.en: : Have fun, you two.
lines.zh: : 你们两个玩得开心。

lines.en: scene black
Rin and I take a seat on the couch and she begins telling me all about her rather brief and uneventful first brush with romance.
lines.zh: 我和 Rin 在沙发上坐下，她开始跟我讲起她那段相当短暂、也没什么波折的初次恋爱经历。

lines.en: But despite saying just moments ago that she didn’t really have anything worth mentioning, she manages to talk for the duration of her break about all sorts of things.
lines.zh: 尽管她几分钟前还说没什么值得提的，她还是在整个休息时间里讲个不停，讲了各种各样的事。

lines.en: Well, all sorts of things relating to Otoha.
lines.zh: 嗯，全是跟 Otoha 有关的各种各样的事。

lines.en: How she’s trying her best to take things slow...where she expects things to go by the end of the year...and even her hopes of being in the same class again once I’m no longer her teacher.
lines.zh: 她是怎么努力想慢慢来的……她预计年底前会发展到哪一步……甚至还希望等我不是她老师之后能再同班。

lines.en: Of course, I don’t say anything about how I’ll be her teacher for the rest of eternity if all goes according to plan.
lines.zh: 当然，我没说如果一切按计划进行，我会当她老师当到永远。

lines.en: Just like I don’t say that I expect this honeymoon period to fizzle out over time...and how I think all connections can be broken ten times easier than they can be formed.
lines.zh: 就像我也没说，我预计这段蜜月期会随时间慢慢淡去……也没说我觉得所有羁绊断裂起来都比建立起来容易十倍。

lines.en: She has achieved her goal for now, but what comes next?
lines.zh: 她现在达成了目标，可接下来呢？

lines.en: If it follows the path of most other [young]romances, I would predict tragedy.
lines.zh: 如果沿着大多数[young]恋爱的轨迹走，我预测会是悲剧。

lines.en: Even with the mass amount of flags popping up, though, Rin doesn’t seem particularly fazed.
lines.zh: 尽管冒出了成堆的 flag，Rin 看起来却并不怎么在意。

lines.en: Obviously, everything Rin says about Otoha is laced with a dose of hormonal excitement...but there’s a complete lack of worry.
lines.zh: 显然，Rin 说的关于 Otoha 的每一句话都掺着荷尔蒙的兴奋……但其中完全没有担忧。

lines.en: In fact, all of the worry I imagined there would be has been swapped out with what feels like a burning sense of conviction.
lines.zh: 事实上，我原本预想会有的所有担忧，都被一种像是燃烧着的笃信取代了。

lines.en: Which raises the question-
lines.zh: 这就引出了一个问题——

lines.en: Why does something still feel off?
lines.zh: 为什么我还是觉得哪里不对劲？

$ cafe50 = True
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}
